en.name: Tomato sauce, homemade and canned
en.summary: This is tomato sauce made at home and preserved by canning in sealed jars, not a pan of sauce poured into a bottle. Properly processed and sealed, it keeps about 9–12 months in the cupboard. An opened jar is an ordinary refrigerated leftover.
en.pantry: Sealed jars keep about 9–12 months in a cool, dark, dry cupboard. That figure assumes a tested recipe processed properly, and tomatoes are the classic case where that matters: modern tomato varieties sit close to the acidity threshold, which is why tested recipes call for added bottled lemon juice or citric acid in every jar. Do not skip it and do not add extra onion, pepper or garlic, which push the acidity the wrong way. Label every jar, store them without their screw bands so a failed seal shows itself, and check each lid is concave before use.
en.fridge: Once a jar is opened, keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and treat it as a cooked leftover — take out what you need with a clean spoon and reheat that, rather than warming the whole jar and returning it. A jar that failed to seal was never shelf-stable: refrigerate it immediately and use it quickly, or freeze it. The same applies to any batch you cooked but did not process.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for home-canned tomato sauce, but freezing is a sound alternative to canning for anyone without the equipment, and it removes the acidity question entirely. Cool the sauce, pack it into flat bags or rigid containers with headspace, and freeze at −18 °C (0 °F). Frozen food held at that temperature stays safe indefinitely; flavour and texture are what drift.
en.thawing: Thaw frozen tomato sauce in the fridge overnight, or tip it straight from frozen into a covered pan over low heat. Bring it to a full boil before serving, and never thaw it on the counter.
spoilage: A lid that has lost its seal, flexes, or pops when pressed
Spurting liquid, fizzing or pressure when the jar is opened
Mould on the surface, under the lid or around the rim
A fermented or yeasty smell, or an unusually darkened, separated sauce
tips: Add the bottled lemon juice or citric acid a tested recipe calls for in every jar, without exception.
Do not bulk the sauce out with onion, pepper or garlic before canning.
Date every jar and use the oldest first.
Freeze rather than can if you are not set up for it — it is the forgiving option.

faq.q: How long does home-canned tomato sauce last?
faq.a: About 9–12 months in a cool dark cupboard, provided it was made to a tested recipe and is properly sealed.

faq.q: Why do canning recipes add lemon juice to tomatoes?
faq.a: Modern tomatoes sit close to the acidity threshold for safe canning. The added bottled lemon juice or citric acid brings every jar reliably below it.

faq.q: Can you freeze homemade tomato sauce instead?
faq.a: Yes, and it is the safer route without canning equipment. Cool it, pack with headspace and freeze at −18 °C.

faq.q: What if a jar did not seal?
faq.a: It is not shelf-stable. Refrigerate it straight away and use it quickly, or freeze it.

zh.name: 自製封罐番茄醬汁
zh.summary: 這裡指的是在家做好、以裝罐密封方式保存的番茄醬汁，不是煮好後隨手倒進瓶子的醬。處理與密封得當的話，放在櫥櫃裡大約 9～12 個月。開封後的罐子就是一般的冷藏剩食。
zh.pantry: 密封完好的罐子放在陰涼、避光、乾燥的櫥櫃，大約 9～12 個月。這個數字的前提是依經驗證的配方正確殺菌處理，而番茄正是最典型必須講究的例子：現代番茄品種的酸度很接近安全門檻，這就是為什麼經驗證的配方會要求每一罐都加入瓶裝檸檬汁或檸檬酸。不要省略，也不要多加洋蔥、辣椒或大蒜，那會把酸度推往錯誤的方向。每罐標日期，存放時拆掉外圈螺蓋以便發現密封失敗，使用前確認蓋子仍然凹陷。
zh.fridge: 開罐後請放 4 °C 以下，並把它當成熟食剩菜——用乾淨的湯匙取出要用的份量加熱，不要整罐加熱後再放回去。密封失敗的罐子從來就不是常溫保存品：請立刻冷藏並盡快用完，或改成冷凍。煮好但沒有做殺菌處理的那一批也一樣。
zh.freezer: 自製封罐番茄醬汁沒有公布冷凍期限，但對沒有裝罐設備的人來說，冷凍是穩妥的替代方案，而且完全免除酸度的問題。醬放涼後裝進平放的密封袋或留膨脹空間的硬質容器，放 −18 °C。食物在這個溫度下安全性可以無限期維持；會變的是風味和質地。
zh.thawing: 冷凍番茄醬汁請放冷藏隔夜解凍，或直接蓋鍋小火從冷凍加熱。上桌前要煮到大滾，也絕對不要放室溫解凍。
spoilage: 蓋子失去真空、按下去會彈動或彈起
開罐時液體噴出、冒氣或有壓力
醬面、蓋子內側或瓶口周圍長霉
有發酵味或酵母味，或醬色異常變深並分層
tips: 經驗證配方要求的瓶裝檸檬汁或檸檬酸，每一罐都要加，沒有例外。
裝罐前不要用洋蔥、辣椒或大蒜把醬量撐大。
沒有裝罐設備就改用冷凍，那是容錯率最高的做法。

faq.q: 自製封罐番茄醬汁可以放多久？
faq.a: 只要依經驗證配方製作且密封完好，陰涼避光的櫥櫃大約 9～12 個月。

faq.q: 裝罐配方為什麼要加檸檬汁？
faq.a: 現代番茄的酸度很接近安全裝罐的門檻。加入瓶裝檸檬汁或檸檬酸能讓每一罐都確實低於門檻。
可以，而且沒有裝罐設備時更安全。放涼、留膨脹空間分裝，放 −18 °C。

faq.q: 罐子沒有密封成功怎麼辦？
faq.a: 那就不是常溫保存品。請立刻冷藏並盡快用完，或改成冷凍。
